title: File:Normal lateral chest radiograph (X-ray).jpg
desc: Lateral  chest radiograph  ("X-ray") taken of a 21 year old woman who presented with pain on the left side of her thorax after colliding with another player during a  soccer  game. It shows a normal chest without any signs of injury.

desc:
edit  
  Computed tomography of the head , without intravenous contrast, here presented in the  axial plane  with 4 mm slice thickness. It shows normal anatomy, with no injuries. The subject is an 18 year old male who had blunt trauma to the head after a 25 m long jump during  motocross .
